regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and ESI statement
regions.finding: Verified the true article title and aggregate Ni/photoredox hydride-free reduction claim. The publisher states ESI availability, but workspace SI association remains unestablished and no SI fact was imported.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and traditional hydride-reduction discussion
regions.finding: The Pd/Cu hydride methods are cited prior literature and are represented only as a generic literature example linked to Figure 1A on page 2, not as current-paper experiments.
The prose introduces the authors' generic Ni/photoredox/protodenickelation concept. Specific current experiments appear on pages 2–5 and are recorded separately.

unresolved: Generic Figure 1 R groups do not define unique structures or experiment-specific quantities.
The ESI link does not establish a workspace SI association.

regions.finding: Classified the Pd/Cu hydride reduction map as cited prior work. Catalyst/hydride alternatives are generic and were not expanded into current-paper rows.

Classified the Ni/photoredox hydride-free reduction and amine-derived proton-source diagram as the generic current concept; the unknown protodenickelation in this overview is not an isolated experiment.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 1 header, entries 1–18, structures, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all 18 optimization rows independently with shared 0.25 mmol/acetone 0.1 M/room-temperature/405 nm/3 h conditions, row catalyst/ligand/photocatalyst/light/amine/time/loading/leaving-group overrides, 19F-NMR yields, entry-14 recovery, and entry-18 conversion.

Mapped the narrative control/photocatalyst/byproduct discussion to the Table 1 rows without duplication. Unidentified photodegradation products remain unstructured because details are only referred to unassociated ESI Table S6.

unresolved: Table 1 omits atmosphere, workup, purification, isolated masses, and isolated yields.
Alternative-photocatalyst byproducts are unidentified in the main paper; SI details were not inferred.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of Table 1 discussion
regions.finding: The DPA derivative and lower-Ni-loading discussion maps to entries 12–18 already recorded from page 2; no duplicate experiments were created.

Mapped internal, terminal, vinylallene, allenol, scale-up, and limitation statements to the 29 independent Table 2 arrows on page 4 and the gram-scale arrow on page 5. Product 24 retains the reported zero yield/degradation failure; path-a/path-b to 25 remain separate.

regions.region: page 3 mechanistic isotope and amine-product discussion
regions.finding: Recorded two isotope-labeling experiments and the iPr2NMe/hemiaminal-34 experiment. The prose's 90% Et3N-d15 incorporation conflicts slightly with Figure 2A's 89% and both values are retained.
Recorded the 1-equiv TEMPO inhibition as a main-text-only partial control and linked the loss-of-stereochemistry statement to the separate (S)-1r Figure 2C experiment.

unresolved: Scope-row workups, purification details, product masses, and atmosphere are not reported.
Et3N-d15 deuterium incorporation is 90% in prose versus 89% in Figure 2A.
TEMPO control details beyond 1 equiv and inhibition are assigned to unassociated ESI and remain missing.

regions.region: page 4 Table 2 common reaction header and key-features box
regions.finding: Applied the common 0.4 mmol/1 mol% DPA-CO2Me/2 mol% Ni and phen/Et3N/acetone 0.1 M/room-temperature/405 nm/24 h conditions only to the displayed scope arrows, with row footnotes overriding scale, loadings, time, and yield basis.
Recorded products 6–24 independently, split the two substrate paths to product 25, and retained product 26 separately. Product 24 is a 0%/degradation failure rather than an omitted row.
Recorded terminal allene 27, regioisomer mixtures 28a/28b and 29a/29b with 4:1 and 13:1 ratios and their distinct mixture/pure-allene yield bases, plus mestranol-derived product 30.

regions.region: page 4 Table 2 vinylallene/allenol grid 31–33 and footnotes a–h
regions.finding: Recorded 31–33 separately and promoted footnote b/c scale, d/e catalyst/photocatalyst loadings, f/g yield bases, and h 72 h into structured fields.
Linked the non-opened cyclopropyl allene 35 and unidentified minor byproducts to the Figure 2C radical-clock record rather than treating the prose as a second run.

unresolved: Complex compact scope structures remain source-labeled with null SMILES where safe encoding was uncertain.
No Table 2 row gives atmosphere, workup, purification, or isolated mass.

regions.finding: Recorded the independent 5 mmol 1a run with exact 1.18 g substrate, catalyst/ligand/photocatalyst loadings, Et3N, acetone 0.1 M, 405 nm/room temperature/24 h, and 0.69 g product 6 in 85% isolated yield.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 2A–C source-of-H, hemiaminal, enantiopure, and radical-clock panels
regions.finding: Recorded two isotope experiments, one iPr2NMe/hemiaminal experiment, one enantiopure-substrate racemization probe, and one radical-clock experiment. Hypothesis cartoons are mechanistic context, not extra preparations.

Recorded one three-trace CV series for complex I alone and with 5/10 equiv 1a, including scan rate, supporting electrolyte, -1.07/-1.52 V waves, loss of reversibility, and the new -1.6 V peak. Proposed II/III are not isolated products.

regions.region: page 5 Figure 2E zinc and electrochemical arrows
regions.finding: Recorded two distinct zinc controls (MeOH gives 20%; Et3N gives ND) and one constant-current electrochemical reduction (68%) with all displayed electrodes, electrolyte, current, charge, time, temperature, and atmosphere.
Classified A–F, PC states, and Ni oxidation-state changes as one proposed mechanism rather than reaction preparations.

unresolved: Several Figure 2 yields lack a stated measurement basis and absolute scale.
Et3N-d15 D incorporation conflicts by one percentage point between prose and figure.
CV solvent/concentrations and several electroanalytical details are not printed.

regions.finding: Linked the -1.07/-1.52 V waves, substrate-dependent current/loss of reversibility, slight shift, and speculative -1.6 V assignment to the existing Figure 2D CV series. Proposed Ni(I)/Ni(III)/Ni(II)-allenyl species remain mechanistic interpretations.
Linked the low zinc efficiency and successful 8 mA undivided-cell electrolysis to the three distinct Figure 2E records; no new prose-only run was created.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left proposed mechanism and conclusions
regions.finding: Linked oxidative addition, decarboxylation, amine oxidation/deprotonation, SET, protodenickelation, and catalyst regeneration to the Figure 2F mechanism record. Conclusions add no new experiment.

regions.finding: Administrative text and bibliography only; cited external experiments were not imported as current-paper records.
